tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search for Drive files using a structured query, e.g. title = 'x' and parentId = 'y'.

tools.name: download_file_content
tools.description: Download the content of a Drive file as a base64 encoded string.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Create or upload a file to Google Drive. Prefer textContent for text; for non-UTF8 content set base64Content. contentMimeType is required with content. Folders: mimeType application/vnd.google-apps.folder. Set disableConversionToGoogleType to keep the content's type.
